_metadata.description: Every operation family is reachable headlessly with report-shaped output; the UI enhances and never gates.

requirements.title: Headless operation vocabulary
requirements.description: Composition, transformation, and analysis operations draw their names from a single vocabulary SSOT and each completes from the CLI with no UI, no ComfyUI, and no interactive prompt, emitting report-shaped output.

validation.notes: Operation vocabulary is declared once and every surface resolves against it
Each operation family completes headless and returns report-shaped output

requirements.title: Deterministic ops need no model
requirements.description: Trim, fade, concat, format and sample-rate conversion, silence trim, and loudness measurement run with zero model download and zero GPU, so the scenario is useful before any weights are installed.

validation.notes: Deterministic ops succeed with an empty model registry
